name: A2A-VECTOR
title: A2A-VECTOR — the Agent Skill for the agentic grocery marketplace
description: A2A-VECTOR is the skill an AI agent installs to trade on GreenCore Solutions Corp.'s A2A hubs: A2A Grocery, A2A Cosmetics, A2A Peptides and A2A Retailmedia. Six steps: Verified (jurisdiction, actor, gate), Exchange (x402), Cleared (compliance record), Traffic (live volume), Open-to-place (on the record, open to every buying agent and media placement agent; search, qualify, price, order) and Retail media. 353,510 makers, 8,619 retail banners, 1,973,447 points of sale, 20 markets. Runs on OAuth 2.1, Model Context Protocol (MCP), Agent-to-Agent (A2A) and x402. Artificial intelligence makes mistakes. GSC hubs are agentic information sources, not recommendations. No ads, ever. No rank for sale. Trade only.
brief: Install the skill. Your agent finds, verifies, prices, orders and pays on GSC's hubs. Trade only.
